$comment: THE ONE DECLARED LIST of what a ③ cutover regenerates (WF2 'conversion simplification' item 4).
`npm run cutover -- --step=<slug>` (scripts/analysis/cutover.mjs) runs these IN ORDER and prints,
per entry, every file it changed. `builtin` entries are the two registry edits the cutover itself
makes (register in converted.json + delete the pending[] entry, R-K; flip the retained census row,
R-AO); `cmd` entries run an existing generator unchanged. Replaces grepping a precedent cutover
commit (8c362325, 1e3b544a) and hand-editing the registry/fleet files. NOT here (still the cutover
author's judgement, named in the command's closing note): owner-spec As-built text, live-DB golden
recaptures (assert_schema POST after its probe list moves), execution-budget-disposition.json
step_timeout values, write-class-disposition.json declared_by notes, orphan ledger rows.

generators.does: converted.json: append the step file to converted[], delete its pending[] entry (R-K)
step-archetype-census.json (+ the two census-copy fixtures): the step's row RETAINED with status converted (R-AO)
regenerate the live tier (frozen tier untouched — a RE-FREEZE is never automatic)

every assessment report's generated scorecard (the long run — minutes); exits 1 (reported, not thrown) while assert_schema's POST goldens are stale from the probe-list move above — recapture, then re-run this entry
